WITH major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.major_id,
        maj.department,
        COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
    GROUP BY m.major_id, maj.department
),
dept_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        SUM(member_count) as dept_total
    FROM major_member_counts
    GROUP BY department
),
major_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        mmc.major_id,
        mmc.department,
        mmc.member_count,
        CAST(mmc.member_count AS FLOAT) / dt.dept_total as share
    FROM major_member_counts mmc
    JOIN dept_totals dt ON mmc.department = dt.department
),
dept_avg_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        department,
        AVG(share) as avg_share
    FROM major_shares
    GROUP BY department
),
major_with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.major_id,
        ms.department,
        ms.member_count,
        ms.share,
        ms.share - das.avg_share as difference
    FROM major_shares ms
    JOIN dept_avg_shares das ON ms.department = das.department
    WHERE ms.share > das.avg_share
)
SELECT 
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    difference
FROM major_with_diff
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
